title: EMU and trade: The euro effect on the agricultural sector
title_zh: 欧洲经济货币联盟与贸易：欧元对农业部门的影响
title_primary: 欧洲经济货币联盟与贸易：欧元对农业部门的影响
title_secondary: EMU and trade: The euro effect on the agricultural sector
authors: Silviano Esteve‐Pérez, Sergio Gil‐Martorell, Salvador Gil‐Pareja
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper uses a structural gravity model to examine the partial equilibrium effects of the European Monetary Union (EMU) on trade for the agricultural sector. We find robust evidence that EMU has increased trade both between members and between EMU and non‐EMU member countries. This positive link is found in most member countries. Moreover, the overall impact of EMU on trade between members has not been different for late and early joiners. The year‐by‐year and period‐by‐period analyses show that the effect of EMU is increasing over time. In addition, we conduct a counterfactual general equilibrium experiment that reveals a remarkable welfare‐enhancing effect of EMU for its member countries.
abstract_zh: 本文运用结构引力模型，考察了欧洲货币联盟（EMU）对农业部门贸易的部分均衡效应。我们发现有力证据表明，EMU不仅促进了成员国之间的贸易，也增进了EMU与非成员国之间的贸易。这一正向关联在大多数成员国中均有所体现。此外，EMU对成员国间贸易的总体影响在后期加入国与早期加入国之间并无显著差异。逐年及逐期分析显示，EMU的效应随时间递增。进一步地，我们实施了一项反事实一般均衡实验，结果表明EMU为其成员国带来了显著的福利增进效应。

title: How to rapidly assess the economic consequences of floods with public data sources? evidence from northern Italy
title_zh: 如何利用公共数据源快速评估洪水的经济后果？来自意大利北部的证据
title_primary: 如何利用公共数据源快速评估洪水的经济后果？来自意大利北部的证据
title_secondary: How to rapidly assess the economic consequences of floods with public data sources? evidence from northern Italy
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper uses high-frequency public data to provide an ex-post evaluation of two floods that hit the Italian region of Emilia-Romagna in May 2023, just a few weeks after they occurred. Using nightlight data to measure output growth and considering a difference-in-differences empirical framework, we find a decline in nightlight growth in flooded municipalities in the three weeks surrounding the two floods, a rebound effect in the following three weeks, but no effect thereafter. In the most pessimistic scenario, the reduction in GDP growth in flooded municipalities in 2023 is between 0.3% and 0.8%, excluding the agricultural sector. The duration of the impact of the floods is broadly confirmed by the other two proxies for economic activity available at the daily frequence and municipal level, i.e. hiring and road traffic data. We also find temporary effects on the housing market demand, but no effects on the house prices asked by the sellers and the number of posted advertisements for house sales, suggesting that the housing market in flooded municipalities already discounts the risk of such natural events.
abstract_zh: 本文利用高频公共数据，对2023年5月袭击意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅大区的两次洪水进行了事后评估，评估时间距灾害发生仅数周。通过使用夜间灯光数据衡量产出增长，并采用双重差分实证框架，我们发现，在两次洪水发生后的三周内，受灾市镇的夜间灯光增长出现下降，随后三周出现反弹效应，但此后无显著影响。在最悲观情景下，2023年受灾市镇的GDP增长率下降幅度在0.3%至0.8%之间，不包括农业部门。洪水影响的持续时间大致得到了另外两个日频且市级层面的经济活动代理变量的证实，即招聘和道路交通数据。我们还发现住房市场需求受到暂时性影响，但对卖方挂牌房价及房屋销售广告数量无显著影响，这表明受灾市镇的住房市场已提前将此类自然灾害风险纳入考量。

title: Institutional investor mandates, securities lending, and short-selling constraints
title_zh: 机构投资者委托、证券借贷与卖空约束
title_primary: 机构投资者委托、证券借贷与卖空约束
title_secondary: Institutional investor mandates, securities lending, and short-selling constraints
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Institutions facilitate short-selling by lending from their holdings, but what they hold is endogenous. This paper examines how institutional demand, driven by investment mandates (benchmarking), affects short-selling. In a model where benchmarked managers lend from their holdings, both lending supply and equilibrium price are higher for the benchmark asset, and so is shorting demand (due to inflated price). A quasi-experiment using Russell index reconstitution shows that stocks with more benchmarked capital have greater lending supply and demand. Ultimately, such stocks are costlier to short. In theory and data, results are driven by incomplete pass-through from benchmarked capital to lending supply.
abstract_zh: 机构通过出借其持有的证券来促进卖空，但其持有量是内生的。本文考察了由投资授权（基准化）驱动的机构需求如何影响卖空行为。在一个基准化管理者出借其持有资产的模型中，基准资产的借贷供给和均衡价格均更高，卖空需求也随之增加（因价格被抬高）。利用罗素指数重构进行的准实验表明，基准化资本占比更高的股票具有更大的借贷供给和需求。最终，这类股票的卖空成本更高。在理论和数据中，这些结果均由基准化资本向借贷供给的不完全传导所驱动。

abstract_zh: 保险在时间与状态两个维度上转移资源。本文在合同覆盖多个消费周期的模型中，研究了流动性约束下保险的消费平滑收益。流动性约束下保险需求的规范基准在定性与定量层面均不同于标准模型：个体可能仅以精算公平价格购买部分保险，可能在保费极高甚至有时处于劣势时仍从保险中获益，并且可能为必然发生的事件投保。通过健康保险的模拟分析，我们揭示了这些发现如何为流动性约束人群设计差异化的成本分摊方案提供洞见。（JEL D86, G21, G51, G52）

title: DP770 The Economics of the International Arms Trade
title_zh: 国际武器贸易的经济学
title_primary: 国际武器贸易的经济学
title_secondary: DP770 The Economics of the International Arms Trade
authors: Paul Levine, Ron P Smith, Somnath Sen
official: 官方在线 1993-03-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper provides a formal model of the trade which allows for competing, forward-looking suppliers whose welfare depends on both the economic benefits from the sales and the security repercussions of recipient behaviour. The recipient's behaviour depends on their military capability which is a function of the stock of arms they have acquired. We first examine myopic recipients, whose behaviour depends on current stocks, then forward-looking recipients for whom questions of the time-consistency and the credibility of supplier threats to embargo, or promises to resupply become crucial. Finally, we examine the impact of supplier cooperation of the sort currently being discussed in the UN Security Council.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个正式的贸易模型，该模型允许存在相互竞争且具有前瞻性的供应商，其福利既取决于销售带来的经济利益，也取决于受援方行为带来的安全影响。受援方的行为取决于其军事能力，而军事能力则是其已获取武器存量的函数。我们首先考察了短视型受援方（其行为取决于当前存量），随后分析了前瞻型受援方——在此类情形下，供应商威胁实施禁运或承诺重新供应的时点一致性与可信度问题变得至关重要。最后，我们探讨了当前联合国安理会正在讨论的供应商合作模式所产生的影响。

title: Estimating the Economic Effects of Federally Funded R&D
title_zh: 联邦资助研发的经济效应估算

title_secondary: Estimating the Economic Effects of Federally Funded R&D
authors: Sheila Campbell, Jaeger Nelson, Eli A. Schrag, Heidi L. Williams, Caleb K. Wroblewski
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In recent years, there has been Congressional interest in changing various policies related to research and development (R&D). Recent legislation has included provisions that would modify federal funding for R&D investments and tax provisions affecting the after-tax price of R&D. The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) has developed analytical frameworks for estimating how changes in R&D investments affect the economy and the federal budget. This paper describes the agency’s current analytical framework for modeling the economic effects of changes in federal funding for R&D, focusing on two distinct approaches that CBO has developed: an R&D capital stock approach and an R&D components approach.
abstract_zh: 近年来，国会一直关注调整与研发相关的各项政策。近期立法中包含了修改联邦研发投资资金条款以及影响研发税后价格的税收条款。国会预算办公室（CBO）已建立分析框架，用于估算研发投资变化对经济和联邦预算的影响。本文阐述了该机构当前用于模拟联邦研发资金变化经济效应的分析框架，重点介绍CBO开发的两种不同方法：研发资本存量法和研发要素法。

title: Strategic communication among banks
title_zh: 银行间的战略沟通
title_primary: 银行间的战略沟通
title_secondary: Strategic communication among banks
authors: Christian Bittner, Falko Fecht, Melissa Pala, Farzad Saidi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How do bank networks facilitate information flows that shape market outcomes? Using international banks’ advisory activities in corporate takeovers as their source of private information, we show in supervisory data that banks with closer ties to the target, but not the acquirer, advisor trade profitably in the target’s stock prior to the deal announcement. This trading behavior is associated with a higher premium paid without compromising deal success. As connected banks’ incentives are aligned only with target shareholders’ interests, which are represented by the target advisor, our evidence suggests that economic incentives determine which banks share information and with whom.
abstract_zh: 银行网络如何促进信息流动并影响市场结果？利用国际银行在企业并购中的顾问活动作为其私有信息来源，我们在监管数据中发现，与目标公司（而非收购方）关系更密切的银行顾问会在交易公告前通过目标公司股票交易获利。这种交易行为与支付更高溢价相关，且不影响交易成功率。由于关联银行的激励仅与目标股东利益一致（由目标顾问代表），我们的证据表明，经济激励决定了哪些银行共享信息以及与谁共享。

title: Inflation after the Iran war
title_zh: 伊朗战争后的通货膨胀
title_primary: 伊朗战争后的通货膨胀
title_secondary: Inflation after the Iran war
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: An unexpected increase in energy costs raises inflation directly through flexibly-set prices. Whether that shock amplifies to a larger and persistent rise in inflation depends on its transmission through the economy. This paper examines four channels of transmission of the Iran conflict to inflation in the EA, UK, and the US. The first is the transmission to the sticky prices in core sectors. Recent advances in menu cost models predict that inflation will rise faster than usual and monetary policy is less powerful to curb it. The second is transmission to spending, wages, and nominal returns through higher expected inflation. The empirical literature on household and firm inflation expectations points to some evidence for this amplification. The third channel is through other aggregate demand policies, especially fiscal policy. The IMF reassessments of the fiscal outlook provide some guarded grounds for optimism. The fourth mechanism is through an erosion in the credibility of the long-run inflation target. Data from market prices indicates that the inflation anchor has not moved. All combined, the data as of May 2026 suggests that the Iran war shock will have a significant impact on inflation that persists into 2027, but that is smaller and more short-lived than the 2021--24 inflation disaster.
abstract_zh: 能源成本的意外上升会通过灵活定价直接推高通胀。这种冲击是否会放大为更大规模且持续的通胀上升，取决于其在经济中的传导机制。本文考察了伊朗冲突对欧元区、英国和美国通胀的四种传导渠道。第一种是向核心部门粘性价格的传导。菜单成本模型的最新进展预测，通胀将以快于往常的速度上升，而货币政策抑制通胀的效果将减弱。第二种是通过更高的通胀预期向支出、工资和名义回报的传导。关于家庭和企业通胀预期的实证研究为这种放大效应提供了一定证据。第三种渠道是通过其他总需求政策，尤其是财政政策。国际货币基金组织对财政前景的重新评估为乐观情绪提供了审慎依据。第四种机制是通过侵蚀长期通胀目标的公信力。市场价格数据显示，通胀锚并未发生偏移。综合来看，截至2026年5月的数据表明，伊朗战争冲击将对通胀产生显著影响，并持续至2027年，但其影响程度小于2021-2024年的通胀灾难，且持续时间更短。

title: Quantifying the Role of Firms in Intergenerational Mobility
title_zh: 量化企业在代际流动中的作用
title_primary: 量化企业在代际流动中的作用
title_secondary: Quantifying the Role of Firms in Intergenerational Mobility
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We quantify the role of firms in intergenerational mobility using administrative data from Israel. We decompose the intergenerational elasticity of earnings (IGE) into an individual-IGE and a firm-IGE using an AKM framework. The firm-IGE—reflecting the sorting of children from higher-income families into better-paying firms—accounts for 23 percent of the IGE.We then explore underlying mechanisms. While skill transmission explains part of the firm- IGE, roughly half cannot be accounted for by skill differences. Moreover, sector-level sorting explains a large share of the firm-IGE, indicating that structural barriers across sectors—rather than firm-level discrimination— are a key driver of intergenerational sorting.
abstract_zh: 我们利用以色列行政数据量化了企业在代际流动中的作用。通过AKM框架，我们将代际收入弹性（IGE）分解为个体IGE和企业IGE。企业IGE——反映高收入家庭子女进入高薪酬企业的分类效应——解释了IGE的23%。随后我们探究了潜在机制。尽管技能传递解释了部分企业IGE，但约一半无法由技能差异解释。此外，行业层面的分类效应解释了企业IGE的很大份额，这表明跨行业的结构性壁垒——而非企业层面的歧视——是代际分类的关键驱动因素。

title: Regulation by Reputation? Intermediaries, Labor Abuses, and International Migration
title_zh: 声誉监管？中介、劳工虐待与国际移民
title_primary: 声誉监管？中介、劳工虐待与国际移民
title_secondary: Regulation by Reputation? Intermediaries, Labor Abuses, and International Migration
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Migrant workers and employers rely on intermediaries to facilitate labor market placements. If information frictions obscure their reputation, however, intermediaries may underinvest in placement quality. Using data on more than 1.5 million Sri Lankan migrants to the Gulf region, we examine the effects of a government-run intermediary rating program that publicly revealed ratings two years after it was announced. Prior to the ratings’ public release, underperforming intermediaries invest in the rating criteria and place migrants in less abusive and more remunerative employment. Our results suggest the government’s threat of quality revelation induced intermediaries to prospectively screen employers and improve placement quality.
abstract_zh: 移民工人与雇主依赖中介机构促进劳动力市场匹配。然而，若信息摩擦掩盖了中介机构的声誉，其可能会在安置质量上投资不足。基于超过150万斯里兰卡移民至海湾地区的数据，我们考察了一项政府主导的中介评级计划的效果——该计划在公布两年后公开披露评级结果。在评级结果公开发布前，表现不佳的中介机构已针对评级标准进行投入，并将移民安置到虐待程度更低、薪酬更优的岗位。研究结果表明，政府以质量信息透明化为威慑手段，促使中介机构前瞻性地筛选雇主并提升安置质量。

title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计
title_primary: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计
title_secondary: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。

title: The Cost of Uncertainty: US–China Tariff Effects on Agricultural Commodity Markets
title_zh: 不确定性的代价：中美关税对农产品市场的影响
title_primary: 不确定性的代价：中美关税对农产品市场的影响
title_secondary: The Cost of Uncertainty: US–China Tariff Effects on Agricultural Commodity Markets
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the impact of US–China trade policy announcements on corn and soybean markets. Using time‐series models, our results show that prospective tariff announcements significantly increased implied volatility (IV), especially during the 2018–2019 trade war. Our results show that corn and soybean markets responded to both countries' announcements. We observe the strongest volatility impacts at the 90% and 95% strikes. Our results indicate that higher IV raised hedging costs for producers, further constricting farm margins– a 7.5% rise in IV increased soybean option premiums by approximately 3.75%. These findings highlight the financial burden imposed by trade policy uncertainty beyond its impact on commodity prices.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了美中贸易政策公告对玉米和大豆市场的影响。基于时间序列模型的分析结果显示，预期关税公告显著提升了隐含波动率（IV），尤其在2018-2019年贸易战期间表现最为突出。研究表明，玉米和大豆市场对两国发布的公告均产生反应，其中在90%和95%执行价水平上观测到最强的波动效应。进一步分析表明，隐含波动率上升导致生产者的对冲成本增加，进而压缩农场利润空间——当隐含波动率上升7.5%时，大豆期权溢价相应增加约3.75%。这些发现揭示了贸易政策不确定性对商品价格影响之外，对市场参与者造成的额外财务负担。

title: Before the Exodus? Young Scientists and the Future of US Science
title_zh: 出走之前？青年科学家与美国科学的未来
title_primary: 出走之前？青年科学家与美国科学的未来
title_secondary: Before the Exodus? Young Scientists and the Future of US Science
authors: Pierre Azoulay, Raffaella Sadun, Daniela Scur
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Shortly after major policy changes to US science funding began in early 2025, we surveyed 916 young biomedical scientists – PhD students and postdoctoral researchers – about their career intentions and expectations. The results document a dramatic shift in sentiment. Barely half of respondents now say they are likely to remain in academia, down 22 percentage points from how they felt six months earlier. The fraction likely to stay in the United States fell by 21 percentage points. Even satisfaction with having pursued a PhD in science declined by 16 percentage points. These are not the complaints of established scientists defending their budgets, but rather the stated intentions of the next generation – the scientists who would, in ordinary times, become the principal investigators of the future.
abstract_zh: 2025年初美国科研经费重大政策调整后不久，我们针对916名青年生物医学科学家（博士生和博士后研究人员）开展了职业意向与预期调查。结果显示科研人员心态发生显著转变：目前仅半数受访者表示可能留在学术界，较六个月前下降22个百分点；可能留在美国工作的比例下降21个百分点；甚至对攻读科学博士学位的满意度也下降16个百分点。这并非资深科学家为维护预算而发出的抱怨，而是下一代科研工作者——在正常情况下本应成为未来首席研究员的群体——明确表达的职业规划。

title: Digital transformation and the profitability of manufacturing: evidence from China
title_zh: 数字化转型与制造业盈利能力：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 数字化转型与制造业盈利能力：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Digital transformation and the profitability of manufacturing: evidence from China
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper empirically studies the impact of digital transformation on manufacturing profitability based on the panel data of Chinese A-share listed manufacturing enterprises from 2015 to 2024. The results show that the digital transformation can significantly improve the comprehensive profitability of the manufacturing enterprises. The main transmission channels are through revenue enhancement and cost reduction. In the expansion test, the effect of the improvement of profitability brought about by digital transformation is more obvious in non-state-owned enterprises and non-high-pollution industries, and the effect remains robust after solving the endogeneity problem. The conclusions fill the void of multidimensional measurement of profitability in existing research, and also provide experience for enterprises to optimize digital transformation strategies, and for policymakers to formulate targeted industrial policies.
abstract_zh: 本文基于2015至2024年中国A股制造业上市企业的面板数据，实证研究了数字化转型对制造业盈利能力的影响。结果表明，数字化转型能显著提升制造业企业的综合盈利能力，其主要传导渠道在于增收与降本。在扩展性检验中，数字化转型带来的盈利能力提升效应在非国有企业及非高污染行业中更为明显，且在解决内生性问题后，该效应依然稳健。本文的结论填补了现有研究中对盈利能力多维测量的空白，同时也为企业优化数字化转型策略、政策制定者制定针对性产业政策提供了经验参考。

title: Tournament auctions with a strong limit bidder
title_zh: 强限制竞拍者下的锦标赛拍卖
title_primary: 强限制竞拍者下的锦标赛拍卖
title_secondary: Tournament auctions with a strong limit bidder
official: 官方在线 2026-05-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider auctions with N “weak-valued” bidders and an 𝑁 + 1 -th bidder who is “strong.” The auction is a “tournament” in which the weaker players bid to win the right to compete with the strong bidder. The sealed bids of all players are binding and the winning bid of the weaker players is entered in a second-price contest with the bid of the strong player. As we already noted in Anderlini and Kim (2024a), the tournament design of the auction generates “overbidding” by the weaker bidders. This is due to the fact that the only way for a weak bidder to win the auction is to win among the weak bidders. We let the values of the strong bidder converge in distribution to an atom above the upper end of the distribution of the weak bidders. If the rest of the distribution is drained away from low values sufficiently slowly, the auction’s expected revenue is arbitrarily close to the one obtained in a Myerson (1981) optimal auction. The auction design is “detail free” — no specific knowledge of the distributions is needed in addition to the identity of the stronger bidder. No information about the actual value of the limit large atom is required. This is important since mis-calibrating by a small amount an attempt to implement the optimal auction can lead to large losses in revenue.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个包含N个“弱价值”竞标者以及一个第N+1位“强”竞标者的拍卖场景。此拍卖采用“锦标赛”形式，其中较弱的参与者竞标以争取与强竞标者竞争的权利。所有参与者的密封投标均具有约束力，而较弱参与者的获胜出价将与强竞标者的出价一同进入第二价格竞赛。正如我们在Anderlini和Kim（2024a）中已指出的，这种锦标赛式拍卖设计会导致较弱竞标者出现“过度出价”现象。这源于弱竞标者赢得拍卖的唯一途径是在弱竞标者群体中胜出。我们让强竞标者的价值在分布上收敛于一个原子，该原子位于弱竞标者价值分布的上端之上。如果分布其余部分从低价值端以足够缓慢的速度被抽离，拍卖的预期收益将任意接近Myerson（1981）最优拍卖所获得的收益。该拍卖设计是“无需细节”的——除了强竞标者的身份外，无需对分布有具体了解，也无需知晓极限大原子的实际价值。这一点至关重要，因为试图实施最优拍卖时，即使校准偏差微小，也可能导致收益大幅损失。

title: A search-based theory of merger waves
title_zh: 基于搜索的并购浪潮理论
title_primary: 基于搜索的并购浪潮理论
title_secondary: A search-based theory of merger waves
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a search-based theory of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) with heterogeneous firms and endogenous search complementarities. We use this model to study how merger incentives, endogenous innovation, and the firm size distribution interact. We derive the law of motion of the firm size distribution, provide closed-form solutions, and solve for firms’ investment in internal innovation and external acquisitions. Strategic complementarities in acquisition incentives can generate multiple equilibria, including an unstable equilibrium with high M&A activity. The model therefore offers a new perspective on merger waves as episodes in which favorable fundamentals and coordination interact to generate temporary bursts of acquisition activity. Competition policy can affect both the level of equilibrium merger activity and the set of equilibria the economy can sustain, with implications for innovation, markups, and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于搜索的并购理论，其中包含异质性企业和内生搜索互补性。利用该模型，我们探讨了并购激励、内生创新与企业规模分布之间的相互作用。我们推导了企业规模分布的动态规律，提供了闭式解，并求解了企业在内部创新和外部收购方面的投资决策。并购激励中的战略互补性可能产生多重均衡，包括一个高并购活动的不稳定均衡。因此，该模型为并购浪潮提供了新视角，将其视为有利基本面与协调效应相互作用，引发暂时性收购活动激增的时期。竞争政策既能影响均衡并购活动的水平，也能影响经济能够维持的均衡集合，这对创新、加成率和福利具有深远意义。

title: Geopolitical turning points and macroeconomic volatility: a bilateral identification strategy
title_zh: 地缘政治转折点与宏观经济波动：一种双边识别策略
title_primary: 地缘政治转折点与宏观经济波动：一种双边识别策略
title_secondary: Geopolitical turning points and macroeconomic volatility: a bilateral identification strategy
official: 官方在线 2026-04-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: • Proposes a new bilateral identification strategy for geopolitical shocks based on geopolitical turning points measured by Δ 2 P R I . • Shows that turning points isolate abrupt, event-driven inflections in political relations, improving signal-to-noise separation for causal inference. • Estimates dynamic causal effects of US–China geopolitical relations on real oil prices using quantile IV local projections. • Finds that improvements in US–China relations lower oil prices in the short run and raise them in the medium run, with larger effects at distribution tails. • Replicates the results for Japan–China relations, supporting external validity of the turning-point instrument and the quantile IV–LP framework. This paper constructs a new identification method to quantify bilateral geopolitical shocks—geopolitical turning points—i.e., abrupt, unforeseen state-to-state political turning points. Geopolitical shocks are captured by the second difference of the Political Relationship Index (Δ²PRI), a monthly narrative-based index constructed from Chinese government and media coverage. Unlike conventional global geopolitical risk indicators, Δ²PRI separates sudden departures from bilateral diplomatic paths so causal estimation is possible in a comparative cross-national context. Quantile instrumental variable local projections (IV-LP) are applied in the paper to estimate the dynamic and asymmetric geopolitical shock impact on world oil prices. It is estimated that US–China relational improvements lower oil prices by 0.2% in the short run and increase them by 0.3% in the medium run, with larger effects at the distribution boundaries of oil prices. Replication from Japan–China data establishes external validity. The paper adds a replicable analysis framework to explain how geopolitical shocks for dyads with heterogeneous institutional history and strategic rivalry spill over into global economic instability.

title: On the relation between rationality and consistency
title_zh: 论理性与一致性之间的关系
title_primary: 论理性与一致性之间的关系
title_secondary: On the relation between rationality and consistency
official: 官方在线 2026-04-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate whether the definition of economic rationality as choice consistency is correlated with decision-making ability. Guided by a theoretical framework, we demonstrate that documented positive correlations may be driven by confounding properties unrelated to consistency. To address this, in a novel experiment, we isolate consistency, measured by the Weak Axiom of Revealed Preference. We show that less sophisticated decision-makers often rely on simple rules and behave consistently, while more sophisticated ones consciously randomize, appearing inconsistent. These patterns determine ambiguous correlations, raising doubts about the choice of language that equates consistency with rationality in economics. Similar content being viewed by others
abstract_zh: 我们探究了将经济理性定义为选择一致性是否与决策能力相关。在理论框架的指导下，我们证明已有文献中记录的正相关关系可能由与一致性无关的混淆属性驱动。为此，在一项新颖的实验中，我们通过显示偏好弱公理来分离一致性。研究表明，决策能力较弱的个体往往依赖简单规则并表现出一致性行为，而决策能力较强的个体则会有意识地随机化选择，从而显得不一致。这些模式决定了模糊的相关性，对经济学中将一致性等同于理性的语言选择提出了质疑。

title: Diffusing Freshness: International Technology Transfers and Trade in Fresh Fruits and Vegetables
title_zh: 扩散新鲜度：国际技术转移与新鲜果蔬贸易
title_primary: 扩散新鲜度：国际技术转移与新鲜果蔬贸易
title_secondary: Diffusing Freshness: International Technology Transfers and Trade in Fresh Fruits and Vegetables
official: 官方在线 2026-03-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To mitigate losses of fresh fruits and vegetables (FFVs), new technologies are increasingly developed across different stages of the supply chain. This study examines how international technology diffusion—specifically innovations targeting FFV loss at the production and transportation stages—affects bilateral trade. We develop a gravity framework grounded in a Melitz‐Pareto model and construct a novel dataset linking patent transfers from the EPO's PATSTAT database to 72 FFV products. Empirical results show that each additional patent transferred from an innovator to a recipient country increases the recipient's exports to the innovator, primarily through growth along the extensive margin. Transportation‐stage technologies, which facilitate export market entry in the technology‐recipient country, exert a stronger effect on exports than production‐stage innovations. Results are robust across PPML, OLS, lagged OLS, and IV estimations. Overall, the findings highlight the critical role of international technology diffusion in lowering entry barriers and promoting trade in perishable goods.
abstract_zh: 为减少新鲜果蔬（FFVs）的损失，供应链各环节的新技术日益涌现。本研究探讨国际技术扩散——特别是针对生产和运输阶段FFV损失的技术创新——如何影响双边贸易。我们基于Melitz-Pareto模型构建了一个引力框架，并创建了一个新颖的数据集，将EPO的PATSTAT数据库中的专利转让与72种FFV产品相关联。实证结果表明，从创新者向受让国每转移一项额外专利，受让国对创新者的出口增加，主要通过扩展边际的增长实现。运输阶段的技术有助于技术受让国进入出口市场，其对出口的影响强于生产阶段的创新。结果在PPML、OLS、滞后OLS及IV估计中均保持稳健。总体而言，研究结果凸显了国际技术扩散在降低进入壁垒和促进易腐商品贸易中的关键作用。
